name: ring elevated row
description: A ring row with the feet raised, making the bodyweight pull harder. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.
